_comment: School hours and Wednesday early dismissal by grade, transcribed from the SFFS Family Handbook (source below). Non-personal (CLAUDE.md section 3), so it lives in git. One file per school year: when the handbook for the next year is out, update the rows and `source`, and the build's version changes with it. `grades` lists the grades a row covers (kindergarten = 0); every grade 0-8 must appear exactly once (tests/school_hours_check.py). Times are the handbook's own wording.

building.label: Drop-off
building.text: starting at 8:00 a.m. — students may not be dropped off before 7:45 a.m. (exceptions for sports practice or early departures for field study programs)

building.label: Morning childcare
building.text: available 7:45–8:00 a.m. for an additional charge (see the Handbook's Extended Day section)

notes: Wednesdays are early dismissal every week, not just on the dates marked in the Important Dates calendar.
Hours are subject to change. Always confirm against the current Family Handbook.
